local_origin: Foot of the exterior wall beneath the centre of the photographic left of the two central first-floor (above street level) dark-green sashes. X to image right along the front, Y into the building, Z up from the pavement.

upper_left_wall_opening.source: Sampling horizontal and vertical intensity-gradient transects, excluding security camera and cable. Outer opening, excluding projecting sill.

upper_right_wall_opening.source: Near right jamb partially screened by tree. Outer opening, excluding projecting sill.

below_left_wall_opening.source: Top attachment/reveal controls. Hanging panel projects in front of the wall, so its flank should not be used as a coplanar jamb.

below_right_wall_opening.source: Tree hides the opposite reveal. Top and lower panel do not share a depth.

door_near_left_of_photo.condition: The door has a shallow arched head. The first exposed leaf edge is recessed. Use door opening height 2.00 m only as a scale prior, sigma 0.15 m.

other_narrow_door.condition: Left portion hidden by utility pole at this station; use a second dated street station.

ground_controls.description: centre foot of facade, top of pavement partly in shadow, ±5px
upper edge of sidewalk along grey base, ±4px

caveat: All names identify objects in this picture. The two narrow doors are unnumbered here. The 2015-04-12 green 337 plate is on the adjoining courtyard gate.
